newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Stay in contraction to US.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Stay in contraction to US.

text.p: The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread continued its recent narrowing trend as the local market extended Tuesday's rally and outperformed the rebound in U.S. Treasuries following its weaker than expected CPI report.

The local market continues to price in a benign outcome to Australia's own inflation report next week, taking the long spread to the U.S. back to levels seen in early February and after trading a 120-130 basis point spread for much of March.

Some analysts believe the spread could narrow to 75 basis points and back to the lows seen at the start of the year, although the risk is that the market has jumped the gun, and priced in all the expected positive news on inflation and wages data due over the couple of weeks.
Differentials to Canada were fairly mixed, while against New Zealand, spreads reversed some of Tuesday's widening as the market there consolidated Tuesday's post-N.Z. CPI rally.
